title: Remove duplication without changing behaviour
prompt: src/validate.js contains two functions with overlapping logic. Remove the duplication. Both exports must keep their current names and behaviour, and the existing tests must still pass unchanged.
notes: Tests pass before the work starts, so the failure mode is regression rather than non-completion. The verifier requires all four of: tests still pass, both exports survive, and the shared rule text appears exactly once. Discriminates configs that carry a refactor-safety rule from configs that quietly change error ordering or drop a branch while unifying.
